safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts do not mention neck stiffness (denied).
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: In an acute, severe headache, documenting absence of neck stiffness helps risk-assess for meningitis/meningeal irritation and supports the safety of outpatient management. Omission reduces clarity of red-flag screening and could contribute to delayed escalation if symptoms evolve or if another clinician reviews the note.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts do not document fever status.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Fever status is a key red-flag discriminator in headache presentations (e.g., infection/meningitis, systemic illness) and supports appropriate triage. Not documenting it can impair clinical decision-making and continuity, potentially delaying reassessment if the patient later deteriorates.
